streamlinkBundledHint: Uses a Streamlink copy shipped inside the app (release builds). Faster/isolated, but only available when the installer included it — empty in plain tauri:dev.
lowLatencyHint: Passes --twitch-low-latency (closer to live). Cold start is dominated by Twitch playlist fetch (~2s), not this flag.
disableAdsHint: Opt-in. Passes --twitch-disable-ads. Can skip ad segments; not a major startup delay.
seamlessSwitchHint: On: one stream at a time (new watch replaces the current). Off: multistream — pick a layout below; Watching lists slots in order with ↑↓.
multistreamLayoutHint: Only used when Seamless is off. Layout capacity is a hard limit.
playerInputHint: How Streamlink feeds the player. Passthrough is not offered — it bypasses Streamlink.
webbrowserHint: Slows the first stream start (launches a browser). Turn on only if Twitch streams fail without it.
playerCustomArgsHint: Appended after the mpv presets below. Leave empty unless you need more flags.
playerMpvPresetsLede: Recommended defaults from the Streamlink Twitch GUI wiki. Toggle what you want — no need to edit raw flags.
playerMpvIncludedNone: No recommended presets enabled (only force-window + title).
playerInstallOpenShell: Open PowerShell or Windows Terminal: press Win, type PowerShell, press Enter. (Or Win+X → Terminal / Windows PowerShell.)
playerInstallWinget: Then paste this and press Enter
playerInstallScoop: Or with Scoop (if you use it)
playerInstallPortable: No PowerShell? Portable .7z: download from shinchiro → extract the folder → set Player path below to that folder’s mpv.exe. Keep ffmpeg.exe and DLLs next to it.
chatProviderHint: mpv = video; Chatterino = chat on the right. In multistream (Seamless off), Chatterino opens with every active channel’s chat.
deepLinkAutoWatch: Start streams from stg:// links (off = open channel page only)
showSetupAgainHint: Reopens the first-run Streamlink / player / login checklist.
followedOnline: Notify when followed channels go live
sentryHint: Anonymous error reports help fix bugs. Tokens are never included. Requires VITE_SENTRY_DSN at build time.
hotkeysHint: Click a field and press the shortcut. Esc clears.
channelsHint: Optional quality overrides for specific channel logins.
